## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` (re-graded from the filed p1) · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue`. Direction: `DrawerContent` takes its classes from the drawer direction

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T16:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `plugin-view`'s record Drawer and the shared `DrawerContent` styles ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the Studio browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`).

- **Why p2, not p1:** the create and edit form renders as a left-pinned bottom sheet on desktop, but it is usable and saves correctly. It runs, but looks wrong.
- **Direction:**
  - `DrawerContent` chooses its classes from the direction: `right` → `inset-y-0 right-0 h-full`, with no top rounding
  - or the form renders in a right-hand sheet primitive; the claimant picks the one that keeps mobile's bottom sheet
- Pins: desktop renders a full-height right drawer; mobile keeps the bottom sheet (control).
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (`dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui`: no path-derived mandate; default tier)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `objectui plugin-view + components: renderDrawerForm opens a right-direction Drawer, but DrawerContent hard-codes bottom-sheet classes, so on desktop the form is a 672×526 sheet pinned bottom-left | the platform path: vaul honours direction and stamps data-vaul-drawer-direction; only the styling ignores it | every user who creates or edits a record through a drawer-layout object view, including Studio → Data → Records → Add record`
Thread-read: 6041701641
Serial constraints cleared: `none` blocking. No other `area:records` card is in flight. objectui#11777 (`pm:queue`, `area:records`, the form's group headings) touches the form renderer, not `ObjectView.tsx` or the drawer, so the surfaces are disjoint and nothing is folded. No open objectui PR touches the files above (read 2026-10-07T16:26Z; open: #11600, #11069). `ObjectView.tsx:2674` is the only `<Drawer direction=…>` caller in `packages/` and `apps/` at `9990f9e`.

Why `Clause-②: no`: a styling fix. A new exported wrapper component would widen `@object-ui/components`' public surface. If the dev takes that route, it is reported before the PR opens, and the seat amends this line.
